Name: Easy Animation Cancel
Author: TekBey
Description:
[b]Easy Animation Cancel[/b]
A streamlined utility mod designed to optimize your tool usage through automated, precise animation canceling. Save time and reduce input fatigue by holding a single, fully configurable hotkey.
[b]Core Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Precision Timer Logic:[/b] Unlike standard macro scripts, this mod utilizes a custom internal timer. It measures the exact millisecond your tool connects and forcefully cancels the animation only after the hit registers, completely preventing "ghost swings".
[*][b]Smart Tool Detection:[/b] The mod dynamically recognizes your equipped item. The rapid-fire cancel applies strictly to Axes, Pickaxes, and Melee Weapons. Tools that require charging (Watering Can, Hoe) are safely ignored, allowing you to play normally without constantly toggling the mod.
[*][b]Native Controller Support:[/b] Completely optimized for gamepad users. The mod reads your direct analog input to ensure your character accurately targets your intended direction without the cursor snapping to the corner of the screen.
[*][b]Stutter-Step Ready:[/b] Custom movement logic ensures that your tools fire perfectly even while you are moving or changing directions.
[/list][b]Configuration & Usage[/b]This mod is fully integrated with the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b], allowing you to tweak settings live in-game without editing text files.
[list]
[*][b]Animation Cancel Key:[/b] Bind the action to any key or gamepad button (Default: X).
[*][b]Turbo Speed (ms):[/b] Fine-tune the delay before the animation cancels.[i]Note: A delay of 130ms is highly recommended for the most consistent and fastest frame rate.[/i]
[/list][b]Installation Requirements[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].

[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (Highly recommended to access the settings).

[*]Extract the downloaded [code].zip[/code] file into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.

[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.
[/list]
